Anya: FYI running a focused triage after the int4 bring-up of ranky3b-v2 — seeing a clear NDCG@10 regression on webdocs_v2_holdout.
Marco: show the delta numbers please.
Anya: float16 NDCG@10 0.386 -> int4 0.349. MRR@1 0.241 -> 0.198. Regression concentrated on queries with length >120 tokens and multi-paragraph candidate docs.
Priya: did the quant pipeline accidentally swap tokenizer or normalization artifacts? we've hit that before.
Anya: checked artifacts: same tokenizer sha, same normalization steps. Also seeing more tied top-k scores under int4 and unstable ordering.
Sam: can you slice by doc length, query length, and answer_density? also try an int8-hybrid (only matmuls quant) run for comparison.
Anya: launching slice run now: ```python -m eval.rerank --model ranky3b-v2 --quant int4 --holdout webdocs_v2_holdout --slices "query_len>120 or doc_paragraphs>3" --out /tmp/int4_slice.json```
Marco: suspect kvpack interaction. For long docs kvpack changes number of tokens sent to the scoring pass; combined with quant kernel rounding it can change the effective context. Try with kvpack off.
Priya: also suggest running on a curated anchor set (~2k gold queries). If anchors are fine, this is dataset/format sensitivity.
Anya: pasted 3 quick failure exemplars for eyeballing:
- Anya: (A) Query: "how to set up two-factor auth for rails app" — baseline top doc contains step-by-step; int4 returns a short generic paragraph. doc ids baseline=doc_34, int4=doc_509
- Anya: (B) Long legal query with inline bullets — int4 prefers a short passage mid-doc; baseline picks full statute section.
- Anya: (C) Multi-paragraph product spec — ordering flips between baseline and quant consistently.
Alex: triage checklist i recommend: 1) run float16 vs int4 per-slice; 2) int8-hybrid experiment; 3) run with kvpack disabled; 4) fix candidate ordering seed and re-eval; 5) run with `--seed 42 --no-batch-fuse` to remove nondeterminism.
Lina: add a tokenization diff check: `diff -u baseline.toks quant.toks | head -n 50` and paste mismatches. even a small bpe offset can shift scoring windows.
Anya: infrajob kicked off: eval cluster=rank-staging-4 job=1943211111 at 2026-03-22T16:12:03Z :gear:
InfraBot: deploybot: started staging job cluster=rank-staging-4 job=eval-1943211111 at 2026-03-22T16:12:03Z :gear:
Priya: also check softmax temperature and fp->int casting in the reranker head. We saw earlier that scaling before argmax changed tie behaviour after quant.
Marco: good point. Dump logits for a small sample to compare distributions: `--dump-logits /tmp/logits_baseline.json` and same for quant.
Anya: will run int8-hybrid and kvpack-off jobs next and post slice table + three example diffs in ~2 hours. :thumbsup:
